sam3_window_01_left_pane.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target. Transform the selected window into a clean catalog reference of exactly one detached left window sash. Preserve the tall aspect ratio, white PVC frame, outer sash, and crossbar layout. Make it a thin planar construction with a shallow frame depth of about 4 cm and one opaque pale blue-gray glass panel. Front orthographic view, centered with generous padding. Remove the blinds, wall, furniture, room, reflections, outdoor scenery, adjacent pane, and any box-like back enclosure. Place it on a perfectly flat solid #ff00ff background with no shadow, gradient, texture, text, or watermark. Change only the presentation and ambiguous glazing content; keep the selected sash identity and proportions.
